name: HTN01: Screened for hypertension
description:
Number of clients active on ART whose last ART visit during the reporting quarter contains a documented Hypertension screening/status assessment.
The patient's latest ART visit during the reporting quarter must have a documented htn_status other than NOT ELIGIBLE. The patient must satisfy the active-care rule.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND a.htn_status IS NOT NULL
  AND a.htn_status <> 'NOT ELIGIBLE'
  AND a.encounter_date = (
      SELECT MAX(a2.encounter_date)
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a2
      WHERE a2.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND a2.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
      WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND (
            x.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR x.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
